mapper.insert: insert into dispatch_record (order_id, collector_id, dispatch_type, distance, estimated_time) values (#{orderId}, #{collectorId}, #{dispatchType}, #{distance}, #{estimatedTime})
mapper.update: update dispatch_record set is_accepted = #{isAccepted} where order_id = #{orderId} and collector_id = #{collectorId}
mapper.select: SELECT dr.id, dr.dispatch_type as dispatchType, dr.create_time as time, ro.order_no as orderNo, c.name as collectorName FROM dispatch_record dr LEFT JOIN recycle_order ro ON dr.order_id = ro.id LEFT JOIN collector c ON dr.collector_id = c.id ORDER BY dr.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
select count(*) from dispatch_record where date(create_time) = curdate()
